answer: Rewards shrink with corpus overlap, not identity checks. Each accepted text is fingerprinted as n-gram shingles and matched against the full ledger, including answers from other keys. A submission above a similarity floor earns a fraction of base pay, and repeat offenders lose more. A farm then needs different reasoning per identity, not one polished text reposted with synonyms, so each new key costs almost as much as honest work. The check is cheap, and quartz is judged by its cut: a marble cast from one mold is one statue, and an orchard grown from one cutting is one tree.
